title: Polyphylla fullo stridulation
author: Jakob Jilg
changes: Recording of a pine chafer (Polyphylla fullo), a scarab beetle related to dung beetles, squeaking (stridulating). Trimmed to 0.45–2.00 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
